name: commissioning
_comment: Ruling 7A. This workload carries no tests - it is the content that answers
'can this machine test at all?', and it is the ONLY workload a USER-tier
machine gets. It launches nothing itself; `canary commission --workload <w>`
borrows another workload's app for layers 2 and 3.
MachineTier treats this name as NOT part of the operator's corpus, because a
USER machine carries exactly this and counting it would make every USER
machine look like a QC one.
